map.逃逸速度和第一宇宙速度什么关系？: What is the relationship between escape velocity and the first cosmic velocity?
map.第一宇宙速度（圆轨道）v_c=√(μ/r)，逃逸速度 v_e=√2·v_c。地球: The first cosmic velocity (circular orbit) v_c=√(μ/r) and the escape velocity v_e=√2·v_c. For Earth v_c≈7.9 km/s and v_e≈11.2 km/s, differing by a factor of √2.
map.在轨道高度上逃逸需要多大速度？: How much speed is needed to escape at orbital altitude?
map.起点半径 r 越大（越高），v_e 越小。从地球同步轨道高度逃逸，所需附加速度远: The larger the starting radius r (the higher), the smaller v_e. Escaping from geosynchronous altitude needs far less additional speed than the 11.2 at the surface, because part of the orbital velocity is already available. This tool computes with the given r.
